current_hypothesis: A PPO-trained controller whose state includes population and real agent task-execution feedback can learn evolution decisions (operator choice or parent selection) that improve LLM-agent task success and transfer to held-out task families, beating fixed, random, adaptive-rule, and bandit baselines.

gate_conditions: C1: no GLEET code copy — independent implementation only
C2: pick exactly one decision family (M1 or M2) before implementation
C3: bandit (B3) and FM-rewrite (B5) baselines mandatory in effectiveness experiments
C4: deeper literature collision check before publication-level novelty claims
C5: if PPO fails to beat bandit on held-out families, STOP this hypothesis
